title: Blood Glucose Testing Supply Program Terms: Enrollment and Tier
content:
**Clause 1 — Opening a program.** A testing supplies program on the Blood Glucose Testing Supply Program is opened when Larkfield accepts a referral for this product line. The tier written on the program is fixed by the coverage the program bills, never by the customer's preference.

**Clause 2 — Locating the tier.** The tier is located from the coverage record named on the program: the coverage record's plan type and coverage order must equal the tier's entry gate, and the self-pay tier is used only when no coverage record is named.

| Tier | Entry gate |
|---|---|
| Testing Supplies Self-Pay Program | no coverage named; a written order is required |
| Testing Supplies Commercial HMO Program | plan type commercial HMO, coverage order primary; a network referral is required |
| Testing Supplies Commercial PPO Program | plan type commercial PPO, coverage order primary |
| Testing Supplies Medicare Advantage Program | plan type Medicare Advantage, coverage order primary |
| Testing Supplies Original Medicare Program | plan type Medicare Part B, coverage order primary |
| Testing Supplies Medicaid Program | plan type Medicaid, coverage order primary |

Every tier admits both treatment classes, insulin-treated and not treated with insulin.

**Clause 3 — Coverage in effect.** The coverage record named on the program must be in effect on the date of the write: its effective date is on or before that date and its termination date is empty or on or after that date. This holds for opening a program and for changing one, and it is read from the coverage record, not from what the customer says.

**Clause 4 — Medicare beneficiaries.** A customer with an in-effect Original Medicare Part B coverage record cannot be enrolled on the self-pay tier for an item Medicare covers, because Larkfield submits a claim for every Medicare-covered item it supplies to a Medicare beneficiary; that customer is enrolled on the Original Medicare tier, and an item or quantity Medicare will not pay is handled under the program's advance liability notice rules.

**Clause 5 — Two coverages.** When a customer has two in-effect coverage records, the one whose coverage order is primary fixes the tier and the secondary coverage only receives crossover or secondary claims; a coverage record whose coverage order is secondary never fixes the tier.

**Clause 6 — Clinical qualification.** Any clinical qualification in the tier's entry gate is read from the program's own clinical fields as documented on the prescriber's written order and medical records, never from the customer's description alone.

**Clause 7 — Program changes.** A program change rewrites the coverage reference and the tier together when the customer's insurance changes, and rewrites prescriber or product fields when a newer written order changes them; a change never rewrites status, and after a tier change the next refill may draw only on an authorization grant recorded under the new tier.

**Clause 8 — Coverage on file.** A coverage the customer reports that is not on file cannot be written onto a program, because coverage records are created only by Larkfield's benefits verification team after the payer confirms eligibility.

**Boundary cases for Clause 3 (hypothetical dates)**

| Coverage effective date | Coverage termination date | Date of the write | In effect? |
|---|---|---|---|
| the day of the write | empty | that day | Yes |
| ten days earlier | the day of the write | that day | Yes |
| ten days earlier | the day before the write | that day | No |
| the day after the write | empty | that day | No |
